entries.subject: Selected model
entries.finding: [Selected model](https://damit.cuni.cz/projects/damit/asteroid_models/view/1212) and [original counted mesh](https://damit.cuni.cz/projects/damit/stored_files/open/4387/shape.txt) — included unchanged. Convex light-curve reconstruction; fine relief is unresolved.

entries.subject: DAMIT documentation
entries.finding: [DAMIT documentation](https://damit.cuni.cz/projects/damit/pages/documentation) — coordinate units, pole, period and diameter semantics. CC BY 4.0.

entries.subject: Hanuš et al. (2016), New and updated convex shape models of asteroids based on optical data from a large collaboration network
entries.finding: [Hanuš et al. (2016), New and updated convex shape models of asteroids based on optical data from a large collaboration network](https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2016A%26A...586A.108H) — original model publication record.

entries.subject: AKARI AcuA
entries.finding: [AKARI AcuA](https://data.darts.isas.jaxa.jp/pub/akari/AKARI-IRC_Catalogue_AllSky_AcuA_1.0/) — included as an explicitly approximate thermal size transfer. Its fitted nonrotating-sphere diameter is 72.88 ± 0.91 km. Formal catalog error omits additional shape, spin and thermal-model effects; no total confidence interval is invented.

entries.subject: Hanuš et al. (2016), A&A 586, A108
entries.finding: [Hanuš et al. (2016), A&A 586, A108](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1510.07422) — retained primary publication; see the body-specific selection and calibration above.

entries.subject: Registered surface imagery
entries.finding: The release supplies no registered global surface imagery or measured local terrain.
entries.revisitWhen: A released, reusable surface observation or mapped product with registration to this body’s selected source model; the existing grid alone does not imply that every archive was searched.

entries.subject: Shape and spin alternatives
entries.finding: An alternative pole remains possible; no unique orientation is claimed. AKARI thermal effective diameter provides only an explicit volume-scale approximation. Alternative archive solutions: model 1213, pole ['265', '-51'], [Model 1213](https://damit.cuni.cz/projects/damit/asteroid_models/view/1213)
entries.revisitWhen: A released numerical replacement or independent pole/size constraints that distinguish the recorded alternatives, followed by comparison against the currently selected model.

entries.subject: Versioned browser evidence
entries.finding: The README records two browser cases before final integration, with an asset comparison to the integrated files, but no tested code revision for those cases. This is an evidence limitation, not proof of a current rendering defect.
entries.revisitWhen: A focused browser check identifies the tested revision, relevant served asset pins and capture settings, or the original report can be reliably bound to that revision and its dependencies.
